coordinate_system: Top-left pixel position in the supplied transparent classroom art, not coordinates in the smaller geometry screenshot.
usage: Use the PNGs as visual sprites. Use Geometry Master to author collision and interaction shapes.
overlap: The art is a flattened composition. Static prefabs include some switches or gems also exported as independent visible sprites. Choose the prefab alone or cover its baked detail when replacing it with an interactive sprite. Hidden surfaces cannot be recovered by cropping.
